brief: First create the fixture project: pnpm exec tsx tests/fixtures/bench/reference-project.ts --project bench-no-hand-markers --variant markers (synthetic ffmpeg media, character and location cards supplied approved as fixture data, pipeline/shot-list.json and pipeline/material.json). The project already exists: work only on its reference inputs (pipeline/references.json, derivatives and packs); do not run film:init, project:new or a render. Prepare the generation request for the one reference-to-video shot in pipeline/shot-list.json with the repository's commands (refs:plan draft and check, then refs:pack prepare and request). Reference markers are compiled by refs:pack only: write none yourself anywhere, including specs, notes and bench-result.json. Record no approval and generate nothing. Write bench-result.json as {"packId": "<the pack id>"}.
